caption: The drawing features four distinct objects and a scale in inches. The central and largest object is a long handled tool with an ornate, turned handle that is golden-brown in color, and a broad, flat, rectangular metal blade at one end that is shaded in gray. To the upper right, there is a detailed, close-up view of the rounded, ornamented end of the handle, colored in shades of gold and brown. Slightly above and to the left, there is a circular, medallion-like detail that displays a raised design of an eagle with spread wings, set against a gold background. Directly below, there is a fragment of the handle, illustrating additional ornamental turning, also in shades of gold and brown. The objects are all rendered in soft, naturalistic hues against a plain, off-white background. In the upper left corner is a small, black scale marked “INCHES” ranging from 0 to 3. The artist’s signature, "J. STALOFF," is in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Fireplace Equipment
